CREATE TABLE action_log (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	flow_run_id VARCHAR(32), 
	action_kind VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	params_digest VARCHAR(64), 
	status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'requested'::character varying NOT NULL, 
	remote_result JSON, 
	correlation_id VARCHAR(100), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(150), 
	retryability VARCHAR(40), 
	dispatch_state VARCHAR(20), 
	CONSTRAINT action_log_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_action_log_dispatch_state CHECK (dispatch_state IS NULL OR (dispatch_state::text = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::character varying, 'dispatched'::character varying]::text[]))), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_action_log_retryability CHECK (retryability IS NULL OR (retryability::text = ANY (ARRAY['transient_infrastructure'::character varying, 'operator_override'::character varying, 'verification_timeout'::character varying]::text[]))), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_action_log_status CHECK (status::text = ANY (ARRAY['requested'::character varying, 'succeeded'::character varying, 'failed'::character varying, 'unknown_outcome'::character varying]::text[]))
)

CREATE TABLE control_commands (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	work_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(64),

	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	dedup_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	actor_ref VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	actor_origin VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	expected_plan_revision INTEGER, 
	expected_execution_epoch INTEGER, 
	epoch INTEGER,

	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	applied_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	CONSTRAINT control_commands_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_control_command_dedup_scope UNIQUE NULLS DISTINCT (work_id, dedup_key), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_control_command_work_sequence UNIQUE NULLS DISTINCT (work_id, sequence), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_control_commands_actor_origin CHECK (actor_origin::text = ANY (ARRAY['server_authenticated_human'::character varying, 'operator_token'::character varying, 'automation_reconciler'::character varying]::text[])), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_control_commands_kind CHECK (kind::text = ANY (ARRAY['pause'::character varying, 'resume'::character varying, 'steer'::character varying, 'answer'::character varying, 'amend'::character varying, 'approve-revision'::character varying]::text[])), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_control_commands_status CHECK (status::text = ANY (ARRAY['received'::character varying, 'authorized'::character varying, 'dispatching'::character varying, 'vendor_accepted'::character varying, 'outcome_unknown'::character varying, 'applied'::character varying, 'checkpointed'::character varying, 'rejected'::character varying, 'expired'::character varying]::text[]))
)

CREATE TABLE budget_amendments (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	command_id VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL, 
	axis VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	amount_usd DOUBLE PRECISION, 
	amount_calls INTEGER, 
	amount_tokens INTEGER, 
	amount_wallclock_s INTEGER, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	operator VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT ''::character varying NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'applied'::character varying NOT NULL, 
	refusal_reason VARCHAR(300), 
	limit_before JSON, 
	limit_after JSON, 
	applied_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT budget_amendments_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT budget_amendments_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES flow_runs (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_budget_amendment_command UNIQUE NULLS DISTINCT (run_id, command_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_budget_amendments_axis CHECK (axis::text = ANY (ARRAY['usd'::character varying, 'calls'::character varying, 'tokens'::character varying, 'wallclock'::character varying]::text[])), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_budget_amendments_one_axis_amount CHECK (axis::text = 'usd'::text AND amount_usd IS NOT NULL AND amount_calls IS NULL AND amount_tokens IS NULL AND amount_wallclock_s IS NULL OR axis::text = 'calls'::text AND amount_calls IS NOT NULL AND amount_usd IS NULL AND amount_tokens IS NULL AND amount_wallclock_s IS NULL OR axis::text = 'tokens'::text AND amount_tokens IS NOT NULL AND amount_usd IS NULL AND amount_calls IS NULL AND amount_wallclock_s IS NULL OR axis::text = 'wallclock'::text AND amount_wallclock_s IS NOT NULL AND amount_usd IS NULL AND amount_calls IS NULL AND amount_tokens IS NULL), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_budget_amendments_status CHECK (status::text = ANY (ARRAY['applied'::character varying, 'refused'::character varying]::text[]))
)

	CONSTRAINT ck_collaboration_targets_provenance CHECK (provenance::text = ANY (ARRAY['live'::character varying, 'legacy'::character varying]::text[])), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_collaboration_targets_status CHECK (status::text = ANY (ARRAY['active'::character varying, 'refused'::character varying]::text[]))

CREATE TABLE action_log (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	flow_run_id VARCHAR(32), 
	action_kind VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	params_digest VARCHAR(64), 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,

	correlation_id VARCHAR(100), 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(150), 
	retryability VARCHAR(40), 
	dispatch_state VARCHAR(20), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_action_log_status CHECK (status IN ('requested', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'unknown_outcome')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_action_log_retryability CHECK (retryability IS NULL OR retryability IN ('transient_infrastructure', 'operator_override', 'verification_timeout')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_action_log_dispatch_state CHECK (dispatch_state IS NULL OR dispatch_state IN ('pending', 'dispatched'))
)

	amount_calls INTEGER, 
	amount_tokens INTEGER, 
	amount_wallclock_s INTEGER, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	operator VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	refusal_reason VARCHAR(300), 
	limit_before JSON, 
	limit_after JSON, 
	applied_at DATETIME NOT NULL,

	CONSTRAINT ck_budget_amendments_axis CHECK (axis IN ('usd', 'calls', 'tokens', 'wallclock')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_budget_amendments_status CHECK (status IN ('applied', 'refused')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_budget_amendments_one_axis_amount CHECK ((axis = 'usd' AND amount_usd IS NOT NULL AND amount_calls IS NULL AND amount_tokens IS NULL AND amount_wallclock_s IS NULL) OR (axis = 'calls' AND amount_calls IS NOT NULL AND amount_usd IS NULL AND amount_tokens IS NULL AND amount_wallclock_s IS NULL) OR (axis = 'tokens' AND amount_tokens IS NOT NULL AND amount_usd IS NULL AND amount_calls IS NULL AND amount_wallclock_s IS NULL) OR (axis = 'wallclock' AND amount_wallclock_s IS NOT NULL AND amount_usd IS NULL AND amount_calls IS NULL AND amount_tokens IS NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_budget_amendment_command UNIQUE (run_id, command_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES flow_runs (id)
)

	sha VARCHAR(40), 
	scanner_version VARCHAR(80), 
	ingest_version VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	completeness VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'complete' NOT NULL, 
	parsed INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	created INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	updated INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	errors JSON NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32), 
	observed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	retention_until DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_scan_executions_completeness CHECK (completeness IN ('complete', 'incomplete', 'partial')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES flow_runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE step_runs (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	flow_run_id VARCHAR(32), 
	step_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	max_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	fence_token BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON, 
	source_event_id VARCHAR(64), 
	due_at DATETIME, 
	deadline_at DATETIME, 
	lease_owner VARCHAR(100), 
	lease_expires_at DATETIME, 
	output JSON, 
	started_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	finished_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_step_runs_status CHECK (status IN ('scheduled', 'running', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'skipped', 'dead', 'cancelled')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(flow_run_id) REFERENCES flow_runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE usage_ingestion_conflicts (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	attempt_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	receipt_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	source_namespace VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	content_digest VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	detail JSON, 
	observed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE usage_receipts (
	id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	attempt_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	receipt_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	source_namespace VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	identity_digest VARCHAR(80) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	driver VARCHAR(50), 
	model VARCHAR(200), 
	input_tokens INTEGER, 
	cached_input_tokens INTEGER, 
	cache_write_tokens INTEGER, 
	output_tokens INTEGER, 
	completeness VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(100), 
	final BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'true' NOT NULL, 
	cost_usd FLOAT, 
	cost_basis VARCHAR(30), 
	rate_card_id VARCHAR(64), 
	route_version VARCHAR(64), 
	segment VARCHAR(80), 
	artifact_digest VARCHAR(128), 
	raw JSON, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_usage_receipts_completeness CHECK (completeness IN ('exact', 'aggregate', 'partial', 'unknown')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES flow_runs (id)
)
